# The error paths of internal/api/tfe that answer without a code of the
# catalog. This list only shrinks: give a path a code, remove its line and
# lower the limit. A new error path never goes on this list.
limit 4
Handler.registryServiceError: default
Handler.writeRegistryAuthError: identity.ErrRateLimited
Handler.writeRegistryDenial: identity.ErrDenied
# One body for the six answers of the registry protocol: 401, 403, 404 two
# times and 500 two times. A code adds errorCode and errorArgs next to errors.
Handler.writeRegistryError: registryErrors{}
